rules.title: Metric Rules & Data Credibility (TokLens Guidelines)
rules.measuredDesc: Collects CommandCode, Codex and Gemini files plus aiusage records; readable raw files take precedence over their indexed copies.
rules.derivedDesc: Cache hit rate is cached input / total input context. Output/input is total output / total input context. Reasoning is shown separately and counted once.
rules.estimatedDesc: Uses recorded costs or local pricing data, with temporary official API rates for historical Codex models when local rates are missing. Unpriced requests retain their tokens and are excluded from known costs.
